title: Starts with
prompt: Return true if the text begins with the given prefix.
signature: func solve(text: String, prefix: String) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(text: String, prefix: String) -> bool:
	return false
hint: Godot names this method begins_with, not starts_with.
solution:
func solve(text: String, prefix: String) -> bool:
	return text.begins_with(prefix)
